heading: How do I convert WebM to MP4?
introduction: Convert a WebM recording to H.264 video in an MP4 container with AAC audio when present. Processing stays in your browser and the original file is never changed.

sections.heading: Choose a compatible output
sections.body: MP4 is widely supported by phones, browsers, editors and sharing platforms. Conversion creates a real MP4 container. Compatible H.264 video can be kept without re-encoding; other supported video codecs are encoded as H.264. It is not a filename-only rename.

sections.heading: Keep the tab open
sections.body: The first media job loads the browser engine. Encoding time depends on duration, resolution, codec and device speed. The converter preserves the source dimensions; long recordings need more time and memory.

sections.heading: Check the result
sections.body: Play the downloaded MP4 with sound before replacing the WebM original. Subtitles and cover art are not retained by the browser encoder.

seoTitle: WebM to MP4 Converter — Free Browser Tool
seoDescription: Convert WebM videos to compatible H.264 MP4 files locally in your browser without uploading them.
